patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with large, blocky typography on the left and an abstract graphic element on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.
A custom, blocky, pixel-art-inspired typeface is used for the main logo and prominent headings, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
High-contrast color scheme primarily using black and white, punctuated by vibrant neon accent colors (orange, purple, yellow, green) for interactive elements and visual highlights.
The primary 'abitcoin' logo in the header remains fixed at the top of the viewport during scroll, while other elements like the floating colored squares in the hero scroll up with the page content.
Alternating dark and light background sections are used to visually separate content blocks and maintain a clear reading flow.

technique_notes: A fixed header element is used to keep the main logo visible at the top of the viewport during scroll. Other elements animate subtly using CSS keyframes, such as the floating colored squares in the hero section, but no scroll-triggered reveals or complex parallax effects are observed.

The site employs a high-contrast visual style with a limited primary palette of black and white, enhanced by a carefully selected set of vibrant neon accent colors to draw attention to key information and calls-to-action.

Typography is used to establish a strong brand identity, combining a custom, blocky display font for impact with a highly legible sans-serif for body content, ensuring both visual distinctiveness and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, blocky headings (~4-5x body) with small uppercase labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout for all interactive elements and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero section, balanced spacing in content sections, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

standout: The distinctive pixelated/blocky aesthetic, particularly in the custom logo and large abstract graphics, combined with a high-contrast black, white, and neon accent palette, creates a unique retro-futuristic and 'cypherpunk' brand identity that feels both modern and nostalgic.
